cards.card_text: Then the writer turns to the believers with GOOD news: "You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One…"
cards.verse_text: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
cards.snippet: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

cards.card_text: With that anointing from the Holy One, the writer says ___ of the believers know the truth.
cards.verse_text: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
cards.snippet: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

cards.card_text: Last word, and the writer comes back to that anointing.
cards.verse_text: And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you.
cards.snippet: And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need…

cards.card_text: With that anointing teaching them, what does the writer tell the believers to do?
